title: Splitting p0 (6wp) to p1 (T75)
author: Andrea Argouarch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8gjhtun
materials: Throw away biohazard materials properly a. 10 cm dishes with glass coverslips should be thrown away in biohazard red sharp container
Discard each coverslip in the 10 cm dish

steps.title: Prepare Surgical Tools and PPE
steps.instruction: Clean surgical tools and don appropriate personal protective equipment.

substeps.instruction: Wear waterproof lab coat and eye protection/PPE.
Brush and clean tools with 409 soap water.
Rinse with water, dry on kimwipe, rinse with 100% ethanol, and dry completely with kimwipe to prevent rust or water marks.
Prepare tools for the next autoclaving cycle.
Turn off UV lights and clean hood with 70% ethanol.
Clean and sterilize hood with 70% ethanol and turn on UV.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Materials
steps.instruction: Gather and prepare all necessary materials and reagents inside the hood, cleaning items with 70% ethanol first.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Autoclaved #5 Dumont Forceps (Fine Science Tools Catalog #11251-30).
Prepare a 10 cm dish for forceps, cell scraper, discarded coverslips, and discarded tissue.
Prepare sterile cell scraper (GeneMate Cell Scrapers & Lifter VWR International Catalog #490000-254).
Prepare DPBS -/- (no calcium, no magnesium, Thermo Fisher Catalog #14190250).
Prepare sterile filtered media with PenStrep (DMEM high glucose pyruvate Thermo Fisher Catalog #11995073, Penicillin-Streptomycin Gibco Catalog #15140122, Fetal Bovine Serum VWR Catalog #97068-091).
Label 1xT75 flask with ID, date, and p1, and add 15 mL of media to the flask.
Prepare 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA (phenol red, Thermo Fisher Catalog #25300062); aliquot and warm before use.

steps.title: Detach Cells from 6-Well Plate
steps.instruction: Process the 6-well plate (6wx6wp) to detach cells after 3 weeks of growth.

substeps.instruction: Rinse each well by adding 3 mL of DPBS.
Lift coverslips with forceps to allow adequate washing under the coverslip and gently swirl.
Add 2 mL of trypsin per well and lift coverslips briefly with forceps.
Place in incubator at 37 °C for ~5 mins until cells start to detach; gently tap the side of the plate to assist detachment from the coverslip.
Add 2 mL of media per well to inactivate trypsin.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Collect all cells from the coverslips and the plate surface.

substeps.instruction: Flip over coverslips within each well using forceps; remove tissue and place in 10 cm dish to discard.
Use cell scraper to gently scrap off cells attached to the coverslip in each well.
Use cell scraper to scrap off remaining cells attached to the bottom of the plate.
Check under microscope and mark areas with remaining attached cells with a pen.
Collect cell suspension in a 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse wells with additional media (~6 mL) to collect any remaining cells.

steps.title: Process Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Concentrate and resuspend the harvested cells.

substeps.instruction: Spin the suspension at 1000 rpm for 5 mins.
Aspirate supernatant, being careful not to aspirate the pellet.
Add media to a final volume of 5 mL and pipette up and down to mix.

steps.title: Seed Cells into T75 Flask
steps.instruction: Transfer the processed cells to the prepared flask and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add the cell suspension to the T75 flask.
Place flask in incubator (5% CO2, 37 °C).

steps.title: Maintain Backup Plate and New Culture
steps.instruction: Perform post-split maintenance for both the original plate and the new flask.

substeps.instruction: Re-feed the old 6wp plate for backup by adding 2 mL of media per well after trypsinization.
Observe and feed the T75 flask the next day to remove debris.
Feed the flask every 2-3 days until 90-100% confluent.
